translations.web: “He will return at the appointed time, and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
translations.bsb: At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time will not be like the first.
translations.kjv: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
translations.asv: At the time appointed he shall return, and come into the south; but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former.
